731: *
732: * Input Parameters:
733: *   dev - Reference to the NuttX driver state structure
734: *   iwr - The argument of the ioctl cmd

742: static int beken_wlan_sta_country(FAR struct netdev_lowerhalf_s *dev,
743:                               FAR struct iwreq *iwr, bool set)
744: {
745:   int ret;
746:   char *country_code;
747:   wifi_country_t country;
748: 
749:   if (set)
750:     {
751:       memset(&country, 0x00, sizeof(wifi_country_t));
752:       country.schan  = 1;
753:       country.policy = WIFI_COUNTRY_POLICY_MANUAL;
754: 
755:       country_code = (char *)iwr->u.data.pointer;
756:       if (strlen(country_code) != 2)
757:         {
758:           wlerr("ERROR: Invalid input arguments\n");
759:           return -EINVAL;
760:         }
761: 
762:       if (strncmp(country_code, "US", 3) == 0 ||
763:           strncmp(country_code, "CA", 3) == 0 ||
764:           strncmp(country_code, "CO", 3) == 0 ||
765:           strncmp(country_code, "DO", 3) == 0 ||
766:           strncmp(country_code, "GT", 3) == 0 ||
767:           strncmp(country_code, "MX", 3) == 0 ||
768:           strncmp(country_code, "PA", 3) == 0 ||
769:           strncmp(country_code, "PR", 3) == 0 ||
770:           strncmp(country_code, "TW", 3) == 0 ||
771:           strncmp(country_code, "UZ", 3) == 0)
772:         {
773:           country.nchan  = 11;
774:         }
775:       else if(strncmp(country_code, "JP", 3) == 0)
776:         {
777:           country.nchan  = 14;
778:         }
779:       else
780:         {
781:           country.nchan  = 13;
782:         }
783: 
784:       memcpy(country.cc, country_code, 2);
785:       ret = bk_wifi_set_country(&country);
786:       if (ret)
787:         {
788:           wlerr("ERROR: Failed to  Configure country ret=%d\n", ret);
789:           return wifi_errno_trans(ret);
790:         }
791:     }
792:   else
793:     {
794:       memset(&country, 0x00, sizeof(wifi_country_t));
795:       bk_wifi_get_country(&country);
796:       iwr->u.data.length = strlen(country.cc);
797:       memcpy(iwr->u.data.pointer, country.cc, iwr->u.data.length);
798:     }
799: 
800:   return OK;
801: }

845: /****************************************************************************
846: * Name: build_scan_results
847: *
848: * Description:
849: *   Format the scan data to respond to wapi command
850: *
851: * Input Parameters:
852: *   scan_req - The private structure to keep the data buffer
853: *   info     - The scan AP data
854: *
855: * Returned Value:
856: *   OK on success.Negated errno returned on failure.
857: *
858: ****************************************************************************/
859: 
860: static int build_scan_results(FAR struct iw_scan_result_s *scan_req,
861:                              wifi_scan_ap_info_t *info)
862: {
863:   int need_len;
864:   FAR char *pointer;
865:   FAR struct iw_event *iwe;
866: 
867: 
868:   need_len = IW_EV_LEN(ap_addr) + IW_EV_LEN(qual) +
869:              IW_EV_LEN(freq) + IW_EV_LEN(data) + IW_EV_LEN(essid);
870: 
871:   if (scan_req->cur_len + need_len > scan_req->total_len)
872:     {
873:       scan_req->cur_len += need_len;
874:       return -E2BIG;
875:     }
876: 
877:   /* Copy scan result */
878: 
879:   pointer = scan_req->buf + scan_req->cur_len;
880: 
881:   /* 1.Copy BSSID */
882: 
883:   iwe                      = (FAR struct iw_event *)pointer;
884:   iwe->cmd                 = SIOCGIWAP;
885:   iwe->u.ap_addr.sa_family = ARPHRD_ETHER;
886:   memcpy(&iwe->u.ap_addr.sa_data, info->bssid, IFHWADDRLEN);
887:   iwe->len                 = IW_EV_LEN(ap_addr);
888:   pointer                 += iwe->len;
889: 
890:   /* 2.Copy ESSID */
891: 
892:   iwe                  = (FAR struct iw_event *)pointer;
893:   iwe->cmd             = SIOCGIWESSID;
894:   iwe->u.essid.flags   = 0;
895:   iwe->u.essid.length  = MIN(strlen(info->ssid), 32);
896:   iwe->u.essid.pointer = (FAR void *)sizeof(iwe->u.essid);
897:   memcpy(&iwe->u.essid + 1, info->ssid, iwe->u.essid.length);
898:   iwe->len             = IW_EV_LEN(essid) + ((iwe->u.essid.length + 3) & ~3);
899:   pointer             += iwe->len;
900: 
901:   /* 3.Copy link quality info */
902: 
903:   iwe                  = (FAR struct iw_event *)pointer;
904:   iwe->cmd             = IWEVQUAL;
905:   iwe->u.qual.qual     = 0;
906:   iwe->u.qual.level    = info->rssi;
907:   iwe->u.qual.noise    = 0;
908:   iwe->u.qual.updated  = IW_QUAL_DBM;
909:   iwe->len             = IW_EV_LEN(qual);
910:   pointer             += iwe->len;
911: 
912:   /* 4.Copy AP control channel */
913: 
914:   iwe                  = (FAR struct iw_event *)pointer;
915:   iwe->cmd             = SIOCGIWFREQ;
916:   iwe->u.freq.e        = 0;
917:   iwe->u.freq.m        = info->channel;
918:   iwe->len             = IW_EV_LEN(freq);
919:   pointer             += iwe->len;
920: 
921:   /* 5.Copy AP encryption mode */
922: 
923:   iwe                  = (FAR struct iw_event *)pointer;
924:   iwe->cmd             = SIOCGIWENCODE;
925:   iwe->u.data.flags    = info->security != WIFI_SECURITY_NONE?
926:                          IW_ENCODE_ENABLED :
927:                          IW_ENCODE_DISABLED;
928:   iwe->u.data.length   = 0;
929:   iwe->u.essid.pointer = NULL;
930:   iwe->len             = IW_EV_LEN(data);
931:   pointer             += iwe->len;
932: 
933:   scan_req->cur_len    = pointer - scan_req->buf;
934:   return OK;
935: }

1080: {

1082:   struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *cpdu;
1083:   unsigned int length;
1084:   unsigned int i;
1085:   int ret;
1086: 
1087:   nxmutex_lock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1088:   length = netpkt_getdatalen(lower, packet);
1089:   if (!g_wifi.carrier || !bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
1090:     {
1091:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1092:       return -ENETDOWN;
1093:     }
1094:   if (length == 0 || length > BK7258_WIFI_MAX_FRAME)
1095:     {
1096:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1097:       return -EMSGSIZE;
1098:     }
1099: 
1100:   for (i = 0; i < CONFIG_BK7258_WIFI_TX_SLOTS; i++)
1101:     {
1102:       if (!g_wifi.tx[i].active)
1103:         {
1104:           tx = &g_wifi.tx[i];
1105:           break;
1106:         }
1107:     }
1108:   if (tx == NULL)
1109:     {
1110:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1111:       return -EBUSY;
1112:     }
1113: 
1114:   memset(&tx->pbuf, 0, sizeof(tx->pbuf));
1115:   cpdu = (struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)tx->headroom;
1116:   memset(cpdu, 0, sizeof(*cpdu));
1117:   tx->pbuf.payload = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)tx->frame;
1118:   tx->pbuf.tot_len = length;
1119:   tx->pbuf.len = length;
1120:   tx->pbuf.type_internal = WIFI_PBUF_TYPE_RAM;
1121:   tx->pbuf.ref = 1;
1122:   cpdu->length = sizeof(*cpdu) + length;
1123:   cpdu->type_dst = 2u;
1124:   ret = netpkt_copyout(lower, tx->frame, packet, length, 0);
1125:   if (ret < 0)
1126:     {
1127:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1128:       return ret;
1129:     }
1130: 
1131:   tx->packet = packet;
1132:   tx->active = true;

1134:                        (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cpdu,
1135:                        (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cpdu, 1);
1136:   if (ret < 0)
1137:     {
1138:       tx->packet = NULL;
1139:       tx->active = false;
1140:     }
1141:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.packet_lock);
1142:   return ret;
